0.why: Pulse.cpp:25 puts getVoltage through a Schmitt trigger at its default 0.1V and 1V thresholds

1.why: Pulse.cpp:30 takes the absolute value of getVoltage; Pulse.cpp:31 follows it with a 5ms rise and a 0.30 second fall

comment: The level bar is scaled in decibels against 4.8V, spanning -48dB to 0dB (Pulse.cpp:45-46), and the peak warning latches for half a second whenever the input reaches 4.8V (Pulse.cpp:35-36). Both bar and lamp are drawn by one custom widget with no parameter behind them, so neither can be clicked for help.
